services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its listed inputs against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -6.5 in August 2026, it is slightly below its 5-year norm; it was unchanged over one month, improved from -18.1 three months earlier, but remains below 2.9 six months ago. ABS mining capex expectations is the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while QLD coal saleable tonnes is the largest negative contributor (-13.3).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its listed inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. The latest reading is +27.2, above its five-year norm, easing from +29.4 a month ago but up from +25.7 three months ago. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the biggest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the biggest negative (-15.5); AISI steel utilisation and discontinued CAT sales are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. The latest reading of -22.7 is below its 5-year norm and has weakened from -7.9 three months ago; fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the biggest positive contributor (+13.6), while AUD/USD is the biggest negative (-36.2). Tungsten policy flags are excluded until enough history is available.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 3 agreements and 2 commissioned cells, with $2.4 million in stated contracted value and no stated recognised value.
